title: The door carries no per-worker harness budget (TICKS_WORKER_TIMEOUT)
body: Finding 8a263ee1's second half, which tick 9iz's acceptance criteria did not name: the wave path derived a per-worker harness budget (workerHarnessBudgetMs, exported as TICKS_WORKER_TIMEOUT) but the door's dispatches still boot unbounded by the control plane. A hung door-dispatched worker runs until the queue-expiry/teardown machinery takes the container, converting a wedged agent into a lost tick rather than a pushed branch the way the wave path did.
